story.title: "Bulgwang Mixing Club" Third Meetup Announcement
story.author: Studio NOL

story.content:
### 🔥 Round 3 scheduled! (But a schedule change notice)

Hello from Bulgwang Mixing Club! We were originally planning the third meetup for this Friday (11/21), but we have good news.

**The entire third week of November is fully booked with recording and mixing sessions!** 🎉

A busy studio means many musicians are making great music, right? We’re spending a hectic week focusing on everyone’s projects.

### 📅 Updated schedule
So the third Bulgwang Mixing Club will be **Friday, November 28, 7:00 PM**.

Friday night is still mixing + pizza & beer! 🎧

### 🎧 Mixing hot spot mode: ON again
“Sharing” and “experimenting” are still the key words. Bring your current project or a mixing point you’re 고민ed about, and we’ll listen together and give feedback on the spot. Gear talk, plugin nerding, reference comparisons—same energy, same passion.

### 📢 3rd meetup info
* **When?** Friday, November 28, 2025, 7:00 PM (Friday night is mixing + pizza & beer!)
* **Where?** Bulgwang Studio NOL, R03 Mixing Room (3F, 84-3 Daejo-dong, Eunpyeong-gu)
* **Fee:** 18,000 KRW (hot pizza + cold beer full set)
  * Studio NOL users are free!
* **Capacity:** Max 6 people, small and focused

### 🚀 How to join
Text 0507-1384-3144 with “I’m in for the 11/28 mixing club!” If you have a track or a mixing issue you want to share, add a quick note.

Sorry for the schedule change, but it’s also proof the studio is in full swing. We’ll make the 28th even better!

See you on the 4th Friday of November at Bulgwang Mixing Club! 🎵
